Explore the Race
Why this run

More than a race. A morning for your health.

Every entry includes real rewards for showing up and moving — for elite runners, first-timers, and kids alike.

Premium finisher medal

Every runner who crosses the line takes home the YBG finisher medal.

Timed chip bibs

Accurate chip timing for the 10K, 5K and 3K timed categories.

Official event T-shirt

A premium Run for Health T-shirt for every participant.

Digital finisher certificate

A personalised certificate to mark the run, sent after the event.

Refreshments & hydration

Hydration support and refreshments to help you refuel on race day.

Age category awards

Recognition for top finishers across age categories, plus race-day photography.

Choose your distance

Four ways to run

Three timed races for every level of runner, plus a free non-timed dash for the kids.

Earn your finisher medal

A medal worth the miles

Every finisher takes home a medal designed to celebrate movement, health and the journey — from the first step to the finish line.

The course

Know the route before race day

An out-and-back course that flags off and finishes at Gate 1, Sanskriti Apartment, Sector 19B, Dwarka — flat and fully marshalled.

2.5 kmCourse (one way)
Out & backFormat
FlatTerrain
  • S

    Start & Finish

    Gate 1, Sanskriti Apartment, Sector 19B, Dwarka.

  • 3K

    3K · Fun

    Turn around at 1.5 km, then back to the finish.

  • 5K

    5K · Community

    Turn around at 2.5 km, then back to the finish.

  • 10K

    10K · Elite

    Two full out-and-back loops of the 5K route.

  • 1K

    1K · Kids

    Inside the park, in regulated, safe surroundings.
